[THE IDENTIFICATION OF PRISONERS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1935]
[THE
IDENTIFICATION OF PRISONERS (SIND AMENDMENT) ACT, 1935]
SIND ACT No. IV OF
1935*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B.G.G., 1955, Pt. V, p.16 and far proceedings in
Council, see Bombay Legislative Council, Debates, 1935, Vol. XLI.] ]
[13th April, 1935]
An Act further to
amend the Identification of Prisoners Act, 1920, in its application to *[Sind].
1. Short title and extent.--(I)
This Act may be called the Identification of Prisoners (**[Sind] Amendment) Act, 1935.
(2) It extends to the whole of *[Sind].
